title: Robots at Home
text:
In the future, many homes will have robots. A robot can clean the floor and cook simple meals. Some robots can also talk to people and answer questions. Many families think these robots will make life easier.

Cars will also change in the future. Some cars will drive by themselves, without a person. People will be able to sleep or read during long trips. Scientists say this will make roads safer.

options: Clean the floor and cook simple meals

options: They think robots will help them
They want to sell their homes

questions.text: Why might people sleep during long trips in the future?
options: They are very tired of cars

to make something free of dirt
the time that has not happened yet
less likely to cause harm or danger

paragraph_translations: No futuro, muitas casas terão robôs. Um robô pode limpar o chão e cozinhar refeições simples. Alguns robôs também podem conversar com as pessoas e responder perguntas. Muitas famílias acham que esses robôs vão tornar a vida mais fácil.

Os carros também vão mudar no futuro. Alguns carros vão dirigir sozinhos, sem uma pessoa. As pessoas poderão dormir ou ler durante viagens longas. Os cientistas dizem que isso vai tornar as estradas mais seguras.
